citation: GTEx Consortium (2024). Genotype-Tissue Expression Project, release v11.
logfc_units: log2FC per year of age (must be scaled x50 for comparability with case-control DEGs)
ischemic_time_correction: REQUIRED — ischemic time correlates with age (r=0.23, p=1.7e-11) and confounds expression. Included as scaled covariate.
table_format_note: Per-row: gene_symbol, log2fc (= per-year coefficient × 50, pre-scaled), padj. If user upload contains raw per-year coefficients, builder applies scaling_factor on the fly.
limitations: TPM normalization (limma-trend) differs from count-based DESeq2 used by GSE datasets. Continuous design may dilute signal at age extremes.
role_in_consensus: Highest statistical power dataset (n=818). Subtle, genome-wide age effects detectable here that case-control studies miss. Critical for cross-validating GSE results.
